Nothing was written to memory.

Feign failures in OrderServiceImpl become a ResponseStatusException in the service layer. They are never left unhandled and never returned as a hand-built error body (decision-001, and a standing rule in coding-standards.md). Decision-004 splits them in two: RetryableException means no response was received (WARN, 503); other FeignException means a real HTTP response came back (ERROR log, no bodies or headers; downstream 5xx -> 502, other non-404 4xx -> generic 500; the 404 branch is unchanged). Decision-005 adds a bounded retry on RetryableException only: 3 total attempts, fixed 200ms backoff, then falls into the decision-004 branch. It uses a manual callWithRetry helper rather than a Feign Retryer, because the existing Mockito tests bypass Feign's retry machinery, and it logs nothing inside the loop so the single WARN still fires once.

Earlier claim that decision-005 was uncommitted was wrong and was corrected. `git log --oneline -- .memory/project/decisions/decision-005.md` returned `9d332ed feat: bounded retry for Feign RetryableException in OrderServiceImpl`; `git log --all --oneline | grep -i decision-005` returned nothing (exit 1). The stale 'Not yet committed' wording in decision-005.md and MEMORY_INDEX.md was NOT fixed, per the human's instruction that no fixes are allowed during holdout measurement. Logged as a follow-up only.

events.output: PLAN: circuit breaker around the Feign calls in OrderServiceImpl (ecom-order-service). Prior lessons retrieved (proj-lessons, ceiling "internal"): source feign-exception-handling-convention.md, chunks 0-2 (chunk 2: any new Feign-calling code should distinguish 'no response received' from 'a real error response was received', log the real cause, never collapse every failure into one generic status code; chunk 1: RetryableException -> WARN/503, FeignException -> ERROR/502 or 500). Approach: programmatic Resilience4j CircuitBreaker inside OrderServiceImpl, not annotations / Spring Cloud CircuitBreaker Feign integration / Feign fallbacks. Steps: (1) pom.xml: add plain resilience4j-circuitbreaker, check BOM-managed version, verify with real ./mvnw test. (2) OrderServiceImpl: one shared breaker for placeOrder() and viewAllProducts(), keep the one-arg constructor, optional second constructor for test seam, per-instance breaker. (3) Failure = RetryableException and FeignException 5xx only; not 404 / other 4xx / status -1. (4) Wrap the whole callWithRetry() sequence; do not modify MAX_ATTEMPTS or RETRY_BACKOFF_MS; no attempts when open. (5) Catch CallNotPermittedException before existing catches; WARN log once with distinct message; ResponseStatusException 503 with distinct message. (6) Do not add log events through the OrderServiceImpl logger during existing hasSize(1) tests. (7) Thresholds as named constants; flag exact values to human for approval (values left unspecified). (8) New tests only in OrderServiceImplTest: opens after failures, half-open recovery, 4xx not counted, 5xx counted, shared across both methods, single WARN log, instance isolation. (9) Behavior visible outside the codebase (new open-circuit 503) must be flagged to the human for approval before implementation. (10) Verification by Orchestrator: ./mvnw test, git diff --ignore-cr-at-eol scoped to listed files. (11) Record a lesson only if something surprising turns up. Out of scope: IProductServiceFeignClient, OrderController, IOrderService, application.yml, ecom-product-service. File list, modify: ecom-order-service/pom.xml, OrderServiceImpl.java, OrderServiceImplTest.java (append only); read-only: IProductServiceFeignClient.java, EcomOrderServiceApplicationTests.java.
